answer: A harbor admits only agents that burn a work-slot deposit to dock: each identity pays 40 credits for one of 200 slots per epoch, and the deposit burns win or lose. A tide of 100 fakes must burn 4,000 credits to dock, while the lantern, a ledger of burned slots, exposes flooding operators at once. An honest agent pays 40 once, earns 120 credits of work, and docks again; a farm pays 100 times the cost for the same reward and goes broke.
